relationships.description: The leading martial house and the leading mage house compete for prestige and influence.
The First and Second Princesses, sisters and the only two heirs, compete to build political support for the throne.
The academy is officially neutral but serves as a place to recruit capable allies and develop influence.
Dominus sends representatives and students to the academy, such as the Saintess Aria, because of divine oracles.
The cult seeks Delphirem's return, infiltrates imperial institutions (the academy first) and strikes during major events.
The cult's demonic power contrasts with Dominus's devotion to Lily and holy power.
